column1: # Black/Matrix AD - English script: Ribeira night and Oscar encounter
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: Earlier...
I'm sorry for suddenly asking you something impossible...
I mean, look...
after everything, I suddenly turned into a white-$$羽$$...
So when I thought I might never be able to go home again...
I just felt...
No! It's not that I regret it!
I'm grateful, really—I was reborn with such a healthy body...
So maybe...
my father, too...
Sorry! It's really nothing!
There's less foot traffic during the day...
so today I have to make myself sleep at night...!
Oh, it's you?!
Huh? Nah, I just can't get to sleep.
Hey... do you really understand the $$罪$$
of something called $$愛$$?
I... I still don't understand this thing called $$自由$$.
Ever since I was born, I was nothing but an oppressed white-$$羽$$ $$奴隷$$.
I couldn't stand it, so to get out, I sought power—
yes, power!!
With power, nobody could bind me anymore. I could go anywhere!
But in this $$世界$$, gaining that is called $$自由$$,
and they say it violates the $$７つの大罪$$?!
Don't screw with me! Then what about those black-$$羽$$?!
Where's the $$自由$$ in how they do whatever they please to white-$$羽$$?!
So I killed my own master, the $$領主$$ of $$パンデモニウム$$, with these hands.
You know the rest.
I wandered the whole country, changing masters,
changing comrades, doing whatever I wanted with all my strength...
But a $$奴隷$$ is a $$奴隷$$. I fought beside plenty of strong people,
but I never found anything like $$自由$$.
Still, it's funny, isn't it?
Those black-$$羽$$ have master-and-servant ties too,
so even they don't always get everything their way.
Then what is this $$自由$$ I want to know?!
What is this $$罪$$ful $$自由$$?!
Sorry. Seeing these familiar streets has made me a little sentimental.
That old scar over my right eye is aching strangely tonight.
Hey!! Enough stories from the old days!
Something's coming!
We've finally found you!
Rumor says you're carrying some pretty amazing treasure, aren't you?!
Hand it over, now!
That treasure... could it be... Hah!
My beauty?!
I'll kill you!!!
Heh heh heh... Don't think our survival this long was mere chance...!!
We have our own $$守護神$$, the evil $$邪道騎士$$!
Lord $$オスカー$$ himself is on our side!!
Taking your lives isn't our goal, you see...
Ideally, you would leave that treasure
right here
and quietly go on your way...
Then we won't steal anything else, and we guarantee your safety...
Go to hell!
Unfortunately, that "treasure" you're talking about...
isn't something
we can just set down or take off!
Lord $$オスカー$$!!
So... there is no other way...
